label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

findings.problem: The cookie banner took focus first, and its settings dialog had several unnamed buttons and unlabeled checkboxes, so I could not tell which toggle was which. About 12 key presses were needed to decline cookies.

There is no way to skip the main menu. Every menu entry has a link plus a separate toggle button, so about 30 Tab presses were needed before I reached the first product, and a [name] delivery notice and rotating banner text kept changing on screen.

In the quick add panel the size choices are list items, not buttons. Enter did nothing on a size, only Space selected it, and the screen only said [name] is selected afterwards, so I first thought it had failed.

After adding to bag the bag drawer opened with the focus on the whole drawer, and about 20 upsell products with their own size pickers sit between the top and the checkout button. I had to go backwards with Shift+Tab to reach the Checkout button at the end.

On arriving at checkout the page was blank with nothing focused and no announcement, and I needed a second read to see the form. Also the shipping country defaulted to [name] with a [name] province list, although the page text was [name].
